lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Roughly 5-6 parallel horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters extending from the posterior gill region across the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, particularly visible in the mid-flank region where they form a grid-like arrangement with high-intensity blobs at the nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank defined by a sharp vertical transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to deep shadow on the ventral side.
